verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮਿ ਤਪੇ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਿਗਿ ਵੇਦ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gotam tape bichaar kai rig vedh kee kathaa sunaiee|

en.bdb: Speculating seriously, seer Gotama has put forth the story of the Rgveda.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਆਇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਕੌ ਮਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਜਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: niaai saasatr kau math kar sabh bidh karate hath janaiee|

en.bdb: After churning the thoughts, in the Nyaya school, God  has been defined as the efficient cause of all the causes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਬਾਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲੇ ਨ ਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sabh kachh karate vas hai hor baat vich chale na kaiee|

en.bdb: Everything is under His control and in His order, no order whatsoever of anybody else is accepted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuhee siree karataar hai aap niaaraa kar dhikhalaiee|

en.bdb: He is in the beginning and at the end of this creation yet in this Shastra he is shown as separate from this creation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: karataa kinai na dhekhiaa kudharat a(n)dhar bharam bhulaiee|

en.bdb: No one has seen or known this creator, and rather people have remained indulged in the expansive delusions of prakriti (nature).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਛਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: soha(n) braham chhapai kai paRadhaa bharam karataar sunaiee|

en.bdb: Not realising that soham parbrahm, the jiv is mistaken in understanding Him as a man (full of fallacies).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਗਿ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: rig kahai sun gurmukhahu aape aap na dhoojee raiee|

en.bdb: The Rgveda exhorts the knowledgeable people that supreme Lord is everything and none else can be compared with Him.
Without true Guru this understanding cannot be attained.
